items.name: MP Maps in Zombies Menu
items.author: Liam-McCormack-Github
items.description:
The menu mod for the MP Maps in Zombies ports. It adds main menu buttons that launch each ported map without console commands, custom loading screen art and text, and options for boss and special zombies.

It also enables sv_cheats and adds a command listener: set zm_cmd <command>.

This is an early beta. Bug reports: [url=https://github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds]github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds[/url]

items.name: Detour (MP Maps in Zombies)
items.author: Liam-McCormack-Github
items.description:
The Black Ops II multiplayer map Detour ported into Zombies, with its own scripts and assets and almost no gameplay changes. It ships its own images, so no DLC is needed. Special enemies, including the DLC 5 ports, appear on every map.

Installs the MP Maps in Zombies Menu, which adds a main menu button to launch it. From the console, with any mod loaded: g_gametype zstandard;map zm_bridge

This is an early beta. Bug reports: [url=https://github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds]github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds[/url]

items.name: Zombies Declassified (DLC 5)
items.author: Logo-2K
items.description:
A work-in-progress PC port of Black Ops II's unreleased fifth map pack, made for Plutonium. Each map is ported, polished and bug fixed to play as close to an official release as possible.

Beta 2 includes nine maps, each with the Ray Gun Mark II in the box:
[list][*]Nacht der Untoten
[*]Verrückt
[*]Shi No Numa
[*]Der Riese
[*]Kino der Toten
[*]"Five"
[*]Ascension
[*]Shangri-La
[*]Moon[/list]
Call of the Dead is planned for the final release. Requires Black Ops II with all DLC.

Source, progress and bug reports: [url=https://github.com/Logo-2K/zombies-declassified]github.com/Logo-2K/zombies-declassified[/url]
